title: The Two of Them Are Pretty Much Like This
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A slice-of-life comedy by Takashi Ikeda about Eri, a thirty-year-old professional writer, and Wako, a twenty-year-old voice actor building her career, who met through work and now live together as a couple. Short chapters follow the everyday humor, stresses and joys of their shared life (Seven Seas blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates).
life_message: A loving, ordinary shared life between two adults, with work and small daily joys, is the good life.

content.note: Adult same-sex couple living together (both databases); AniList Nudity tag at 45% and MangaDex 'suggestive'.
